releases.notes:
# Waypointer 1.12.0
## Added
- New UI refresh, including main UI, community routes, your routes, settings, appearances, everything!
- You can now modify all appearance settings on a cascading appearance section (Global > Zone > Route > [Room] > Waypoint), you can change appearance settings for an individual waypoint or all of your routes.
- You can classify dungeon actions as *Do in any order* from the waypoint menu. Mostly for dungeonbreaker blocks.
- Room completions can now be timed
- Dungeon routes now work in 'steps', where the step you're on shows its actions and its secret together, rather than just going from waypoint to waypoint.
- Doing a later action in a step skips ahead to it, and a secret you grab early is skipped when the route gets there. (no more getting stuck on a missed etherwarp lol)
- You can now import SecretRoutes f7 boss routes
- You can now give routes icons (right click -> Icon)
- *Peek* in the route editor hides the waypoint list so you can watch your coordinate edits in the world.
- Menu opacity in Settings > System lets you see the world behind the menus while editing
- *Add subwaypoint here* in the waypoint menu adds a new subwaypoint where you're standing
- *Reset to route color* puts a colored waypoint back on the route's gradient color for that spot.
- `/wp target` shows/pins the route that new waypoints and commands go to.
- Added more commands for almost everything in the menus: routes, waypoints, folders, appearance, publishing and more. See `/wp help`.
- Support for Odin's new Waypoints module.
- Routes uploaded to the mining cult discord (will) automatically go to Waypointer's route catalog with a new pretty purple tag! :D

## Changed
- New, better algorithm to recommend routes in the route browser.
- Master Mode / Normal Mode function the same in dungeon rooms for the most part now.
- Edit mode in a dungeon room shows the whole route including finished rooms
- New waypoints go to the route you are using: the one you last edited in that area, or the one drawn in a dungeon room. They no longer go to whichever route is listed first (weird that it did that in the first place, sorry command-first users! didn't know so many people would use them ngl...)
- Subwaypoints now fade in and out like main waypoints. "Skip fade time" is now called "Waypoint fade time".
- Less explanatory text in menus and settings.
- Translations updated for every language that had them.
- Improved debug output

## Fixed
- Waypoints added in a dungeon room no longer go to a hidden route.
- Add where looking now works in dungeon rooms.
- Blocks mined out of order no longer hold up dungeon routes.
- `/wp` suggestions work on Hypixel again. (i think ive finally fixed it!)
- A known Crystal Hollows structure no longer turns into an 'approximate' waypoint when you walk into its area.
- Recoloring one waypoint no longer resets the rest of a gradient route.
- Unbound keybinds no longer show as conflicting with each other.
- Minimap area names move aside instead of disappearing behind markers.
- Shared route names can no longer use color codes or hidden characters to look like something else.
- Fixed `Â·` showing between waypoint tags in the route editor. (can't believe i missed this on last release)

## Performance
- Long routes render much faster in the Crystal Hollows.
- Faster minimap, community route maps and route list.

releases.notes:
## Added

- Create Crystal Hollows structure routes that move with their structure between lobbies.
- Track Crystal Hollows structures on a movable, resizable minimap. Edit it with `/wp minimap`.
- Edit published routes, replace their waypoints, or change visibility without changing their share links.
- SkySoft waypoint compatibility
- Undo and redo changes in the route editor and painter.
- Optional Skyblocker structure sharing, with nearby checks that hide inaccurate coordinates. (if you are on the skyblocker team and want this shut off please create an issue, i can shut it off immediately)
- Share known structure coordinates with one click when another player asks in chat.
- Send feedback in-game with screenshots (these go directly to my email pls dont spam)
- Use `{distance}`, `{index}`, `{total}`, and `{route}` in waypoint names! (also, did you know you can use colors? try `&aTEST`!)

## Changed
- Browse My Routes in a searchable, full-screen grid.
- Fuzzy search for settings
- Adjust waypoint placement distance with the mouse wheel (can now be placed midair!)
- Open structure routes directly from the Structures folder
- Keep structure markers visible during focus mode
- Added more data to `/wp debug`
- Chat coordinate Block buttons are now optional and hidden by default.

## Fixed
- Closer waypoints and labels now draw in front of distant ones.
- Fixed crashes when changing player searches in the route catalog.
- Fixed missed area changes when sidebar information arrives late.
- Newly installed dungeon routes now activate without removing older packs.
- Wishing Compass checks now work between the Crystal Nucleus and surrounding areas.
- Fixed overlapping Wishing Compass labels.
- Local structure detections now replace unverified shared coordinates.
- Rejected publisher names now reopen Choose Publisher Name with the error visible.

## Performance
- Faster searches

releases.notes:
# Waypointer 1.10.0

## Added

- Crystal Hollows structure detection and automatic sharing with other Waypointer users.
- Wishing Compass solver and Crystal Nucleus waypoints.
- Fast metal detector solver
- A Structures folder and dedicated mining settings.
- Short published route codes and links.
- ChunkLogger route imports.
- Backward route progression when retracing your steps.
- Separate colors for previous, current, and upcoming waypoints, with smoother transitions between them.
- Optional smoothing for waypoint outlines, route lines, and tracers.
- More control over waypoint labels, including opacity and camera effects.
- A confirmation screen before importing configuration changes.
- A contributor badge and custom color for acidangels.

## Changed

- The new waypoint renderer is now enabled by default.
- All new Waypointer share codes use the WP: prefix.
- Your publisher identity now carries across launcher profiles.
- Coordinates-only exports are now the default, with clearer controls for choosing what to export.
- Etherwarp notification sounds are configurable.
- Waypoint Painter and 3D route previews are grouped under Extras settings.
- Clearer settings navigation, import feedback, and export previews.
- Publishing warns when custom waypoint painting will not be included.
- Translation fixes and updated UI checkmarks.

## Fixed

- SecretRoutes imports and incorrect Mineshaft targeting.
- Tracers becoming unexpectedly thin.
- Route-specific Paint appearance now takes priority over the global appearance setting.
- Focused temporary waypoint beacons stay visible when beacon mode is Off.
- Improved image import compatibility and painter behavior.
- Open Editor now opens the route you just imported.
- The route catalog resumes loading correctly after returning from another screen.
- Temporary and generated routes stay separate from saved folders during edits, copies, and bulk actions.
- Safer recovery from damaged configuration files.
- Turning off structure sharing or letting shared locations expire no longer loses your own discoveries.

## Performance

- Much faster rendering for waypoint clusters.
- More responsive route exports, publishing, and large-route previews.
- Faster paint previews and fewer repeated texture uploads.
- Less background traffic for structure sharing: 80% fewer routine snapshots under normal conditions, while new discoveries still share immediately.

releases.notes:
Waypointer 1.8.7 is here. This is mostly a cleanup update, massive code changes and architectural improvements, with some refactoring and assessment of comments.
Hopefully no issues occur!

Lots of attention to detail changes not mentioned here.

## Highlights

* New 3d route preview on the export screen. Enable in Settings -> Sharing -> Export screen.
* New appearance page in settings that consolidates all of the appearance options
* You can now choose dungeon waypoint types directly while adding or editing a waypoint, including secrets, Etherwarps, Dungeonbreaker, Superboom, pearls, items, and bats.
* `/wp import` now accepts route, settings, and (waypointer/odin) dungeon routes.
* New icons painted by me in Aseprite. I'm no artist, so if you have any better do feel free to make a PR ^_^

## Improved

* Large imports and exports now process off of the game thread (improves performance)
* Dungeon routes are smaller, and codes from earlier Waypointer versions still import.
* Importing a single route now keeps the name stored in its share code.
* Route and waypoint lists are easier to search, scroll, navigate with a keyboard, and use with narration.
* Waypoints, tracers, and edit outlines now remain visible through glass and other translucent blocks.
* Waypoint commands now use the same one-based waypoint numbers shown by `/wp list`. Route indices remain zero-based.
* Numeric settings reject invalid or out-of-range values
* Dungeon rooms now complete from the actionbar secret count instead of a green checkmark from the dungeon map.
* The Everything settings preset has been replaced with Disable All.

## Removed

* Removed the one-click community dungeon-route downloader and its first-dungeon prompt. Manual file imports remain available through `/wpd import <file>`. (Didn't feel right bundling someone else's hard work in my mod.)
* Removed the in-game dungeon route recorder and its test, reset, room, and waypoint commands. (Too imprecise)
* Removed route timers and personal-best tracking. (Useless, but can readd if requested. Also a bit unpolished and haven't planned on improving it.)
* Removed the seven waypoint-editor shortcuts added in 1.8.6. (These were not supposed to make it to prod lol)

## Compatibility

* Supports Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2; both builds require Java 25. No 1.21.11 release for this version.

releases.notes:
## Added

* Added interface translations for 67 (lol) languages
* On Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2, added waypoint editor shortcuts for:
  * Tiny and filled subwaypoints
  * Hide after parent reached
  * Stand, interact, and mine triggers
  * Line-of-sight rendering
* On Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2, added automatic, configurable colors for dungeon waypoint actions.
* Added dungeon route controls for visible secret stages, route lines, tracers, Ender Pearl trajectories, and secret-completion sounds.
* On Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2, added an option to start route connector lines from Etherwarp height.

## Changed

* Redesigned the export page with clearer format selection, content controls, zone controls, and previews.
* Improved settings search and keyboard focus.
* Improved waypoint and group editing, including clearer movement feedback and easier flag review.
* Private-world routes can now move to another zone.
* Imported and downloaded dungeon secrets now use normal editable routes.
* Moved or edited dungeon routes now update without a reconnect.
* Improved waypoints, tracers, labels, beacons, and route lines near the player.
* Improved compact route and settings codes.
* Invalid or damaged share codes now show better errors.
* Contributor badges now appear in chat, the player list, and player name tags.

## Fixed

* Fixed covered or moved routes not loading after an edit.
* Fixed several dungeon route progression problems.
* Fixed chest interaction and room detection in dungeons.
* Fixed custom dungeon room-data problems.
* On Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2, hardened waypoint paint image imports and fixed texture cleanup after a failed texture build.
* Fixed route and settings values being lost during import, export, or restart.
* On Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2, invalid Waypointer configuration files are moved aside before default settings are saved.
* Improved performance-test reliability and recovery after an interrupted test.
* Fixed SkyHanni route exports using the wrong format.
* Fixed rendering issues when Iris shaders are active.

## Removed

* Removed the `/wp devmode` command and its help entry. (didn't really do anything...)

## Compatibility

* Supports Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2; these builds require Java 25.
* A separate Minecraft 1.21.11 build is available and requires Java 21.
* This release supersedes the earlier plan for 1.8.5 to be the final Minecraft 1.21.11 release -- mostly just fixing a crash and performing maintenance. I don't plan on doing another update for 1.21.

releases.notes:
## Added
- Entirely new waypoint/settings/all GUIs, far simpler and cleaner.
- New v9 codec -- even smaller codes!
- New setting to disable text shadows on waypoint labels for better performance

## Changed
- Improved performance.
- Redesigned API to be much nicer
- Improved performance tester
- Fixed some issues with how Waypointer handles secrets in dungeons
- Removed github update checker

## Fixed
- Fixed some dependency issues



### v8 → v9 improvement across 300+ routes

**302 routes** & **31,418 waypoints** for both codecs.

| What improved | Legacy v8 | Production v9 | Improvement |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Total compressed route data | 147,056 B | 73,073 B | **50.3% smaller** |
| Average exported command | 610 B | 306 B | **49.8% smaller** |
| Typical route (median) | 232 B | 123 B | **47.0% smaller** |
| Large route (P95) | 1,197 B | 759 B | **36.6% smaller** |
| Routes fitting one chat message | 185/302 | 225/302 | **40 more routes** |
| Total 256-byte chat messages needed | 846 | 529 | **317 fewer messages** |
| Routes where v9 produced a smaller command | — | 301/302 | **99.7% of routes** |

v9 cuts the typical export roughly in half and lets 40 additional routes fit into a single chat message.
